timing: Written after v3 fit completion, resume replay, and first aggregate inspection.
observed_problem: MML recovery rows did not carry PersonDistribution, so the first aggregate collapsed four distributions within design even though RunId and every estimate remained intact.
scope_assessment: No rating, truth, estimate, SE, likelihood, fit status, constraint, completion marker, or eligibility flag is changed. The defect is confined to aggregation metadata and summaries derived from that metadata.

remediation.metadata_source: Join ConditionId, Design, PersonDistribution, and Replicate from the byte-retained manifest.csv by unique RunId.
remediation.validation: Any nonmissing artifact metadata that conflicts with the manifest fails closed before replacement.
remediation.new_gate: All nonempty run, recovery, and threshold tables must have nonmissing PersonDistribution drawn from the registered four-level condition set.
remediation.output: Write a new aggregate_corrected directory; retain the first aggregate directory unchanged as superseded diagnostic evidence.
remediation.provenance: Validate completion markers against the frozen execution script/amendment hashes stored in study_identity.json, while recording the current aggregation script and this amendment hashes separately.

claim_limit: This is a deterministic metadata repair, not a result-dependent estimator, condition, denominator, or gate-threshold change. Preflight remains operational only.
